title: KnowGPO: Knowledge-Grouped Policy Optimization for Search Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.22331v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deep search agents solve knowledge-intensive tasks through long-horizon, multi-turn interactions, where assigning credit to individual search decisions is fundamentally difficult. Outcome-based reinforcement learning provides only a single terminal reward shared across an entire trajectory. Recent process-supervision methods aim to assign credit at finer granularity, but they typically anchor credit to either surface-level trajectory states or model-internal signals, both of which become unreliable in deep search where observations are heterogeneous and retrieved contexts are long and noisy. We propose KnowGPO, a reinforcement learning framework that aligns trajectories by the task-relevant knowledge they have acquired rather than by their surface observations. translated_title: KnowGPO：面向搜索代理的知识分组策略优化
translated_abstract: 深度搜索代理通过长时程、多轮交互来解决知识密集型任务，在这种场景下，为单个搜索决策分配信用（credit）从根本上是困难的。基于结果的强化学习只能提供在整个轨迹上共享的单一终端奖励。近期的过程监督方法试图以更细的粒度分配信用，但它们通常将信用锚定在表面层次的轨迹状态或模型内部信号上，而这两者在深度搜索中都会变得不可靠，因为深度搜索中的观测是异构的，检索到的上下文又长又嘈杂。我们提出了 KnowGPO，这是一种强化学习框架，它根据轨迹所获得的与任务相关的知识（而非其表面观测）来对齐轨迹。对于每个查询，KnowGPO 将推导答案所需的信息分解为原子化的知识条件，并通过子……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: KnowGPO 提出了一种强化学习框架，通过将推导答案所需的信息分解为原子化知识条件，依据轨迹所获得的任务相关知识而非表面观测来对齐轨迹，从而解决深度搜索代理中信用分配困难的问题。
en_tdlr: KnowGPO is a reinforcement learning framework that solves the credit assignment problem in deep search agents by aligning trajectories according to the task-relevant knowledge they acquire—decomposing required information into atomic knowledge conditions—rather than by surface observations.
